summary: The prepared base reproduces the exact silent argument loss: VisionFlash4Attention omits window_size and sinks at the external FA4 boundary, and the resulting independent reference output differs. At exact candidate commit 0e62b84dd92e886fb4567887881439a2fa8c3458, the wrapper forwards window_size (defaulting to (-1, -1)), conditionally maps non-None s_aux to sinks, and retains ver=4. The candidate regression and independent adversarial boundary cases pass. This verifies the original source-level forwarding contract, but not CUDA FA4 kernel execution or MiMo multimodal output quality on Blackwell.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression run unchanged against the prepared base. All five cases failed: four boundary cases lacked window_size and the end-to-end VisionAttention path disagreed with the independent local-window/sink reference.

Five CPU tests passed at the exact candidate: defaults, window-only, sink-only, combined forwarding, ver=4, and VisionAttention-to-backend behavior compared with an independent small-tensor local-window/sink reference.

Independent adversarial boundary checks for forward_metadata precedence, asymmetric (0, 2) window forwarding, identity-preserving zero-valued sinks, ver=4, full_attn suppression, and no-sink defaults.

gpu_execution.evidence: The interpreter reports torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2, and AMD Instinct MI350X. Tests intentionally used CPU tensors and an instrumented external FA4 boundary. CUDA-only FlashAttention-4 and the NVIDIA Blackwell model path cannot run in this ROCm environment; mocks are not counted as GPU execution.

remaining_limitations: CUDA-only FlashAttention-4 kernel execution was not physically tested because the assigned architecture is AMD MI350X with ROCm, not NVIDIA Blackwell/CUDA.
MiMo-V2.5 weights and an end-to-end multimodal Blackwell serving run were unavailable, so visual-feature/output quality is not independently qualified.
The candidate changes only Python and tests; repository-environment.json provides no native build target, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The numerical reference validates intended local-window and sink normalization semantics at the external boundary, not the implementation of the unavailable FA4 kernel itself.
